title: Reduction quantified Boolean formula
statement: For a nondeterministic Turing machine $N$ with Boolean symbols, natural numbers $d,c$, a deterministic Turing machine $V$ over Booleans, and natural numbers $CV,cV$, define the quantified Boolean formula associated to a Boolean list $x$ to have quantifier prefix given by the reduction quantifiers at length $|x|$, followed by one existential quantifier for each serialized clause in the conjunctive normal form of the reduction circuit on $x$; its matrix is that conjunctive normal form.
hypotheses_covered: $N$ is a nondeterministic Turing machine over Booleans
$V$ is a deterministic Turing machine over Booleans
